final_prompt: Original seven-icon fantasy strategy campaign identity sheet for The Six Unbound Oaths: six materially distinct oath tokens around an open bronze concord ring, followed by bear-paw hedge gate, marsh bell and ripples, wind cairn vane, living branch cartwheel, scarred iron shield and yard hammer, and harbor flare mast over mist; hand-painted readable relief icons, exact 4x2 layout with empty final cell, no text, no franchise symbols, genuine transparent background.
background_extraction_prompt: Remove only the entire dark gradient background and replace it with genuine alpha transparency; preserve all seven icons, grid positions, scale, colors, materials, lighting, shapes, spacing, and fine edges; no halos, additions, restyling, rearrangement, text, or watermark.
runtime_pipeline: Each equal sheet cell is deterministically cropped to a transparent 512px square; the campaign emblem is Lanczos-downscaled to 128px and six chapter seals to 64px with 64-color RGBA quantization. Generated source masters remain excluded from Linux and Windows release packages.

assets.non_color_identity: Six materially different oath tokens remain separate around one deliberately open bronze concord ring.
A broad bear paw holds an iron-banded hedge gate inside a round field of leaves.
A squat bronze marsh bell hangs over concentric ripples between two reed clumps.
A tall uneven stone cairn supports a crosswind vane beneath a small rayed sun disk.
Two forked living branches cross over a six-spoked wooden cartwheel with leaf clusters at their tips.
A tall asymmetrical iron shield carries three deep diagonal scars beside a square-headed broken-yard hammer.
A tall timber harbor mast bears a caged flame above a curling pale mist wake and dark foundation rocks.
